add.issue.comment.md:
Solution: Implemented in PR #1 (commit d41279c on main, rebase-merged). fixtures/synthetic is a nonproprietary Go template (library, command, table test, mise.toml pinning go 1.27.1 chosen from `mise ls-remote go` 2026-09-09); fixtures/bin/make-fixture.sh instantiates it in a fresh uniquely-named temp root with one commit plus staged/unstaged/untracked changes, absolute-link worktree wt-abs and relative-link worktree wt-rel, runs the real build/test through mise, and writes the full run log to FIXTURE.txt; fixtures/bin/fixture-snapshot.sh captures working-tree blob hashes for every tracked+untracked file, index.ls-files/index.tree, head.commit/tree/branch, status.porcelain-v2/short and worktrees.porcelain, or compares current state to a snapshot and fails on drift. Cleanup is exactly `rm -rf <instance-root>`.

Verified 2026-09-09 on macOS 25.6.0 arm64 (git 2.55.0, mise 2026.9.3): instance hestia-fixture-ZvvOL055 created; relative worktree links resolved WITHOUT `git worktree repair` (git worktree list and rev-parse --git-dir --git-common-dir both resolved from wt-rel); mise installed go@1.27.1 in 4.2s; `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` passed in the dirty tree (ok example.com/hestia-synthetic/greet 0.248s); no-change compare matched, tampering NOTES.md reported one-line drift with non-zero exit. CodeRabbit review passed with no findings. Downstream tickets WGHQ2GW, JP73P2D and 4AC12YE can now consume the fixture.
